properties.description: The executable form of ver:the-per-open-design-cost-is-measured, whose method was prose until 2026-09-27. It builds N real-sized copies of a design under one registry root, each under its own graph_id, and opens them one by one. At each step it reads VmRSS, VmHWM, RssAnon and RssFile, then times a burst of writes. Options: --server-arg passes server flags (for example --store-memory), and --no-search tells opening apart from searching. It is the instrument req:one-open-design-costs-a-deliberate-amount-of-memory asks for before and after any change to how stores use memory.
properties.name: tools/measure_open_design_memory.py — what one open design costs in memory, and what writing to it costs in time
